correctness.rationale: The rational root test excludes ±1 for all integral parameters; exact cubic discriminant D=(u²+u-3)²−32; divisor-of-eight exhaustion gives only u=−4,3 for square D. Explicit reductions in Q[Z]/(Z³+Z²−2Z−1) locate the two cubic roots in the real conductor-seven cyclotomic field. Frobenius fixed-point types in C3/S3 plus Chebotarev and Hensel prove all fixed-parameter prime-density and prime-power claims. Replayed finite checker supplements, not replaces, these steps.

value.rationale: Prime divisibility of integer values of the canonical ABC cubic is a natural arithmetic invariant. The claim closes the exact exceptional set left by generic Hilbertian S3 statements for this smallest cubic unit-polynomial specialization and establishes a sharp arithmetic density transition 2/3→1/3. It identifies a shared cyclotomic field and the entire prime-root spectrum at all good prime-power depths. It is an infinite natural classification rather than a one-off example or routine reparameterization; classical Chebotarev is appropriately cited as an ingredient.
